body:
**Font and interface scale**
- **Settings ▸ Interface language** has two new choices: **Font** (the theme's default, the Windows font, or any font installed on the PC) and **Interface scale** from 85 to 140 %. Titles keep each game's own font. **Reset** puts both back.
- At a large scale, the sidebar scrolls as a whole, and the openmods cards put their buttons below the text, so nothing gets cut off.
- Nothing changes for a player who leaves both settings alone. Thanks to HumanMus1c, who made this.

**Also new**
- Scroll areas no longer show a dotted frame after a key press.
- Traditional Chinese: the app's own words in a few texts (thanks, CooperZhuang).

**Install:** unzip `uemm_2.4.0.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. One zip for every game. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays. `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_2.4.0.zip` is the same file under its old name, for older versions of the app.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
